source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U01: Distinguish agreement,promise,acceptance and enforceable contract

payload.title: A business conversation has several legal stages
payload.core_explanation_md:
An invitation to discuss terms is different from a definite proposal. Acceptance must match the proposal in the required way; a response changing a material term is not automatically unconditional acceptance. The accepted promise and reciprocal consideration support an agreement, but enforceability also requires the legal essentials.

Oral arrangements can have legal effect, while particular transactions require writing, registration or other formalities. A signed page does not cure an unlawful object, and an unsigned discussion is not automatically a concluded bank facility. Identify the communication, terms, intention and transaction-specific formalities before deciding what has been formed.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a reply changing a material term necessarily accept the original offer?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Matching acceptance and a changed proposal must be distinguished.

payload.stem_md: A customer replies to a definite facility proposal with a materially different repayment obligation. Staff mark the original terms unconditionally accepted. What must be examined?

options.text_md: Only whether the reply was polite
Whether the bank printed the proposal
options.explanation_md: Printing does not establish matching assent.

options.text_md: Whether the response accepts the original terms or proposes a change
options.explanation_md: A material qualification cannot simply be ignored.
Balance does not prove agreement on terms.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A material qualification cannot simply be ignored.

payload.stem_md: A document is signed but concerns an unlawful object. Which conclusion follows about the signature alone?

options.text_md: It does not establish an enforceable contract despite the unlawful object
options.explanation_md: Formal signature cannot cure every substantive defect.

options.text_md: Every signed agreement is enforceable without exception
It automatically creates all required statutory registrations
It determines the court outcome regardless of evidence
options.explanation_md: The full legal relationship must be assessed.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Formal signature cannot cure every substantive defect.
